late_delivery.name: Late Delivery Policy
late_delivery.description: Customers whose orders are delayed may request cancellation, refund, or replacement depending on order status and eligibility.

damaged_order.name: Damaged Order Policy
damaged_order.description: A delivered damaged item may qualify for refund or replacement after verification. High-value actions require human approval.

cancelled_order.name: Cancelled Order Policy
cancelled_order.description: Cancelled orders may be eligible for a refund depending on payment and cancellation status.

general_support.name: General Support Policy
general_support.description: Issues that cannot be verified using available customer, order, and policy information should be escalated to human support.
